entries.content: Press conference (much print stories) in AM and Session in afternoon at AAAS on Influenza (see above).

Did Podcast interview with Diane Rehm on the anti-VAXX measles situation that is still getting much attention. I used to be a regular on her show before she retired. Her show has been replaced with “A-1”, a mostly political show. I was on once about 1.5 years ago, but never since. Political situation still “hot and heavy” with everyone waiting for the Mueller report. Trump still egregiously lying about everything. Congress did not vote money for his wall and so he has declared a “National Emergency” to use other government funds to build the wall without approval by Congress. States suing and calling this unconstitutional. Many Dems now throwing their hats in the ring for the Democratic nomination for President: Kamala Harris, Bernie Sanders, Amy Klobachar, Kirsten Gillibrand, Elizabeth Warren. Still waiting on Joe Biden.
USG closed due to snow storm. I am the “Lone Stranger” in my office today.

Went for the day to the University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of Medicine to be the John Morgan Visiting Professor and give Grand Rounds. I gave my “5 Presidents”. It was extremely well-received. Was told that it was the largest crowd ever to attend grand rounds. People sitting in the stairwells. Saw a bunch of old friends: George Shaw, Beatrice Hahn, Alain Rook, etc. I was “on my game” and it was a very enjoyable visit. Chris having a bad month first with norovirus She is off to Boston this weekend to visit Jenny.

Did VOA radio interview on Ebola. Also BBC News Facebook interview on Measles and anti-VAXX movement. The measles issue is getting a lot of play since there are reports of outbreaks throughout the world. Many in Europe, 900 deaths due to measles in Madagascar (due to low vaccine rates); 212 dealth in the Philippines.

Did Senate briefing sponsored by Sem. Ed Markey and Congreswoman Rosa DeLauro on influenza znd universal influenza vaccine. Ed and Rosa co-sponsoring an influenza vaccine bill to authorize $1billion over 5 years starting in 2020. I gave opening talk in a group including Florian Krammer, Jesse Bloom, Scott Hensley, Ian Wilson, Gary Nabel, among others. Chaired by David Baltimore and Simon Wain- Hobson. That evening went to Children’s Inn reception at the Rayburn Building. Debbie Dingel and Roy Blount shouted me out during their speeches. Chris came since she is on the Board of the Children’s Inn.

Testified at a Hearing of the House Energy and Commerce Oversight and Investigations Subcommitteeon measles and anti-vaxx movement. Testified with Nancy Messonnier of CDC. Good hearing except that it was intermittently disrupterd by anti-Vaxx activist who kept shouting that we were liars and in bed with drug companies. Chairperson Diana DeGette had to warn that she would clear them from the Hearing is they did not stop. Also, I was asked whether measles vaccine caused encephalitis. I thought for a moment and said “no”. The activists started screaming. Nancy quickly joined in and said in a rare case, in a situation when someone is immunosuppressed, there can be encephalitis associated with vaccine. I then said “Yes, in a rare case”. The activists then started tweeting that I perjured myself and lied under oath. In fact I corrected myself and when I got back to the office, Greg Folkers found a paper that showed in a case controlled study of over 2-3 million children there was no association of measles vaccine and encephalitis. Noneheless, I still got e-mails that night from activists (5 or 6) saying I perjured myself. The e-mails were identical word-for-word. Crazy people.

Did a filming of an upcoming (September) PBS documentary on HIV/AIDS with a folcus on Ryan White and the new initiative to end HIV in the US. Some people still sending e-mails and tweeting about the measles hearing. I have drafted a response to send to them saying: “Thank you for your note to Dr. Fauci regarding his testimony at the February 27, 2019 hearing held by the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Oversight and Investigations regarding the resurgence of measles in the United States. Dr. Fauci’s initial response when asked whether the measles vaccine can ever cause encephalitis was based on a published report that failed to find an increased risk of encephalitis after measles vaccination in a study of more than 2 million children (Ray et al., https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/16940831). However, Dr. Fauci immediately agreed with the clarification offered by the other witness from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, who noted that in fact there have been very rare occurrences of encephalitis after measles vaccination. This very rare occurrence, in the context of hundreds of millions of children vaccinated, is noted on the CDC website ( https://www.cdc.gov/vaccinesafety/vaccines/mmr-vaccine.html) and on the package insert. Dr. Fauci regrets any confusion that his initial statement may have caused. We will work with the Committee to clarify this point in the hearing record.” Will have dinner with Gepi Pantaleo tonight at Fiola Mare. He is in town on hs way to the CROI meeting that I will go to on Monday.

Still getting e-mails from the anti-Vaxxers regarding the briefing. Now they are asking questions that they clearly know the answers to in order to find some discrepancies. Went on Canadian TV (CTV) to discuss measles and the anti-Vaxx movement. Did it by Facetime. Off on Sunday to Seattle to present at CROI the Ending HIV Plan.

Flew to Seattle in AM. Presented Special Lecture at Opening Session of the CROI meeting in Seattle. 4000 people in audience. Extremely well received and much interest in the issue. I flew back on red eye flight that night. At the meeting was presentation (embargo broken) of 2nd BM transplant with CCR5delta 32 to HIV-infeceted person with Hodgkins. Press blowing it out of proportion. Spent most of day on Mar. 5 after flying in on red eye giving 2 Senate staff briefings on he plan and then doing media all day to discuss the transplant. Spent most of the time downplaying it since people are claiming it as a major breakthrough. Was on NPR “Morning Edition”; WTOP; MSNBC; NBC Nightly News; multiple print (Reuters, Rolling Stone); BBC TV; WJLA (Channel 9 Local); Fox News TV (Local)

Continue to have much press about the “London” patient presented at CROI. Did interview today on (CBC) Canadian Radio; Sirius Radio. I have been trying to keep this in proper context since the press starts off by having me comment on this “incredible breakthrough” with a cure around the corner. Also, ABC NewsOnline.

A lot of print and other press that I am involved in around the “London” patient. I have written at the invitation of The Washington Post an Op-Ed about the relevance of the London patient. Currently being “cleared” through the White House. Let us see what happens. Continue to do blog and lower level media almost on daily basis: Contagion interview on HIV/TB; VOA TV on Ebola; World Radio Podcast on AMR, all on Mar. 8
White House approves my Washington Post editorial with virtually no changes except 1 word.
Did Hill TV interview via skype on the London Patient. My Washington Post Op-Ed went ONLINE today. Will come out later in print (never did come out in print).

Did an Interview on Stage with David Rubenstein for the Lasker Lessons in leadership function. The OXCAM students at NIH asked for me as their speaker and Mike Lenardo decided to have David do an interview. Nice evening. Always like bright, enthusiastic students, who (not to self-agrandize), idolize me (truly).
Did TV interview for VOA with Greta Van Susteren on HIV cure.

Busy day today. Testified before the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee Hearing on Ebola and other emerging ID threats – C-Span. Then presented the Plan to end HIV in USA to the PACHA – Also, televised.

Went to the Indian Treaty Room of the EEOB to brief the Domestic Policy Council (Joe Grogan and Katy Talento) and OMB people (DeAngelo and Mark have a juror who is the private physician to the prosecuting attorney. Everyone smiled. After I left the judge told the returning jurors that the woman was taken care of by a “world-famous physician”. The Washingtonian magazine reported this the next day. I did not talk to the magazine because of patient confidentiality and the magazine mentioned this in their story.
Appeared on Turkish TV (TRT) to discuss the anti-VAXX issue.

Went to book party at the home of Jane and Calvin Cafritz ( ) to celebrate Bill Haseltine’s book World Class. Book on the success of the NYU Langone Medical Center. Ran into David Pearle who was a few years behind me at Cornell and NY Hospital. He told Chris that I was a legend at Cornell even before I was Chief Resident 😊 The Mueller report came out yesterday with a blast. Found Russians definitely interfered in our 2016 election, but there was no collusion of Trump with Russians. Also, although the report could not confirm a crime obstruction of justice, the report could “not exonerate Trump regarding obstruction of justice”. However, as soon as the report came out, Trump claimed compete exoneration of both collusion and obstruction of justice. Typical!

Republicans now demanding apologies/resignations of CNN, Washington Post, Congress officials. Much debate about AG Barr’s interpretation of Report. Dems demanding to see the entire report. Mistrust of Barr’s interpretation of report in his 3.5 page letter. Something strange going on here. Intersting side bit. Bob Cousy received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Trump. Trump got on the phone with Cousy to congratulate him and inform him of the Medal and Cousy told the POTUS: Another Holy Cross graduate received the Medal and he really deserved it since he has saved millions of lives. His name is Anthony Fauci

Had video meeting in the SCIF with Bob Kadlec, Laura Caliguiri, Kyle Johnson (CDC). Here again, Bob Kadlec is talking about “believable intell” on “bad actors” (China, Russia; possibly Iran and North Korea) pursuing bioterror activities with agents that are mutated and escape vaccine/drugs. Also, deadly metabolic inhibitors that are “untraceable”. I have heard this story multiple times over the years (since 9/11 and anthrax – see above), and they have never panned out under close scrutiny. Problem is that now we will begin again in investing considerable resources to defend against these “threats”

Measles situation heating up, particularly in Rockland County, NY with Hassidic Jewish community. Now 153 cases. In USA, now have 314 cases in 2019, more than double the entire year of 2017 (120 cases). Did interview on BBC World News Radio. Also, did interview on Fox News Radio from NYC on the officials in Rockland County calling an emergency, not allowing unvaccinated children (1 to 18 years) in public places and imposing civil penalties ($500 or jail time) if they do not comply. Also did a Skype interview with the online program Now This on the ebola outbreak in DRC Went tonight to a reception/buffet ggiven by the Lerner Family and George and Mari Will (at their home – to celebrate the 2019 season of the Washington Nationals. Clearly the Triple A social group. Every media person that you can think of was there – to name a few: Chris Matthews, Chris Wallace, Jon Karl, Gloria Borger, Wolf Blitzer. Many pols – Ted Cruz, Chris Van Hollen. Supreme Court justices – Sam Alito, Brent Kavanaugh. Ted Lerner (Owner of Nats); Edward Cohen (Principal owner and Vice Chairman of the Nats). Ed was the one who invited me. I helped him with a health problem some time ago. Jeff Wilpon (son of Mets owner Fred Wilpon). Nats are playing Mets on Opening Day tomorrow.
Nats lose 2 – 0. Max Scherzer strikes out 12 and still loses. Nats not hitting. Still much buzz about measles outbreaks. Did interview with Axios (Eileen O’Reilly).

Did interview with journalism students from University of Missouri on HIV history. NBC TV local (WRC) interview on adult vaccine schedule versus children vaccine schedule. Recent outbreak of Mumps in Philadelphia – waning immunity. Visit from Karen (Kingry) Olsen who brought her 29 year old gay son Dillan and his partner to my office to give them a history of the gay community and HIV and my role in the process from the 1980s.

(Sunday) – Situation has been brewing for a few weeks and coming to a head. Issue is the use of more widespread vaccination in DRC with the VSV product as well as the Janssen Ad26/MVA. The epidemic borders between smoldering and going completely out of control. Right now, there are 1069 cases and 665 deaths. Over 20+ health zones are involved and >50% of new cases are untraceable to a contact and many are identified after death. Security issues are serious with rebel groups, including Mai Mai bruning ETUs. More than 90,000 doses of VSV vaccine have ben administered in both a ring approach and somewhat (limited) geographic approach. VSV running low and need for Ad26. However, Ad26 requires 2 doses 56 days apart, making it more appropriate for geographic pre-emptive use than contact use. The epidemic is really out of control. Of late, Bob Redfied has been urging WHO to utilize the vaccine in a much broader public health approach. This is being delayed by a number of factors including bad advice that Tedros (Director-General of WHO) is getting from his internal people. Interestingly, they (who had been against research) now want to do a clinical trial (cluster randomization) of the VSV versus Ad26. There is no research question here regarding efficacy that can be answered by such an approach. Anna Maria Restrepo (WHO) and her crew are doing the usual WHO delay in getting a protocol started and this is delaying the deployment of the vaccines for public health versus research. Also, for reasons that I cannot understand, Anna Maria is telling Tedros that there are ethical issues in distributing the AD26/MVA vaccine. Tedros (good guy) is concerned about safety, when Cliff maintains that we have ample data on safety and immunogenicity of both VSV and Ad26/MVA from the PREVAC study that is already fully enrolled. PREVAC is a placebo-controlled trial of VSV and AD26/MVA in Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia and Mali. Bob Redfield arranged a conference call today between me, Bob, and Jeremy Farrar to join forces in convincing Tedros to go with broader geographic vaccination with both products: VSV for contacts and Ad26/MVA for broader pre-emptive. I called up Stewart Simonson in Geneva and explained situation to him and he will explain the issue to Tedros. Also, he will arrange for Tedros and Bernhard Schwartlander (WHO) to call me today or early next week. Other players involved are Peter Piot from London School and Richard Hatchett of CEPI who want to do the research trial; yet I hear that Peter is also with us on broader use. The latter is the typical two-faced problem that we have faced with Peter (see below) and even with Jeremy. It is a complicated situation. A series of subsequent calls took place on this Sunday. Stewart arranged for Bernhard Schwartlander to call. Stewart called a few times and I spoke with Cliff multiple times (he was driving to and from soccer match for his daughter). I had a good 40 minutes conversation with Bernhard over the phone. The situation is complicated. Berhard and Tedros really want my involvement in this discussion because of my global credibility. They need to be careful in what they do and say because “they are WHO”. They are concerned about saying that the epidemic is “out of control” since this creates complex issues for them. They are afraid of acting too boldly and afraid of being criticized (as with the West Africa outbreak) of not acting quickly enough. We discussed the pros and cons of vaccine trials (that really will not provide efficacy data) to distribute vaccine versus just distributing it in a public health exercise. Bernhard referred to the advice he is getting from Mike Ryan, who he considers an expert of these issues (Cliff completely disagrees even though he likes Mike Ryan). Bernhard is also concerned that he does not want WHO to look like they are playing favorites with a company, in this case Janssen. Remember, Paul Stoffels is pushing hard to have his vaccine (Ad26/MVA) used in any way (trial or deploy) in DRC. Peter Piot in my mind is playing both ends. He believes that we must distribute vaccine yet he is getting money from CEPI to do the cluster randomization trial. Yikes! Very complicated situation. More to come.

(Monday)– Busy day regarding whether or not to employ wide vaccination in DRC versus sticking with ring/contact vaccination. I have spoken to Bernhard, Jeremy (by phone on Sunday and today via teleconference from Geneva). Jeremy is at Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) meeting in Geneva that I was supposed to attend. However, I have 2 Congressional hearings and a House member briefing today and tomorrow. The situation is as follows. Bob Redfield, Jeremy Farrar, Cliff Lane feel that the Ebola outbreak in DRC is out of control (100 cases last week). And even though WHO is claiming that the VSV ring vaccine approach is working, the outbreak still progresses. It has not spread into other countries and so WHO is reluctant to call it a Public Health Crisis of International Concern. They are very conservative. I spoke to Bernhard and Mike Ryan and will speak with Tedros tomorrow. Bottom line – WHO people want to stay the course and are concerned about widespread vaccinations in geographic manner. They talk about “ethical” considerations that puzzle me. Geographic vaccine would require using the Janssen Ad26/MVA vaccine since they have millions of doses (2 million for now and more coming). They would have to distribute this on a protocol since they do not have an emergency use authorization. To get it, they have to declare an emergency, which WHO is reluctant to do. However, DRC could declare their own emergency. Both sides want me to weigh in because of my “gravitas” and credibility. I think that they should do widespread since they have been doing the same thing for months and the outbreak is still out of control. As usual Anna Maria Restrepo is the obstruction.

I spoke this AM with Tedros who really wants my opinion. I told him that he needs to be more proactive and not get caught like Margaret Chan and be left behind. He is torn since he listens to his people (Mike Ryan and Anna Maria, yet he knows that I, Cliff, Jeremy, Bob Redfield among others want to be more proactive with vaccine distribution. Met in person with Sec. Azar in usual Ebola update meeting (I usually do by phone, but was downtown for Hearings). I explained to Alex the vaccine situation in DRC. He totally supports our approach of proactive vaccine. We will both meet with President of DRC on Friday Had House Appropriations Subcommittee Hearing today as well as House Energy and Commerce (Diana DeGette) briefing on Ebola. Both went very well. Also gave remarks at Japanese Embassy (4000 Nebraska Avenue, NW) on occasion of Cherry Blossum Festival celebration of 50+ years of US-Japan Bilateral Program. Appear on FOX News TV with Laura Ingraham discussing Measles and AFM. Went well. Greg did not want me to go on program since he hates Laura. She was great with me.

Discussions continue about trying to convince Tedros to listen to us rather than his staff concerning vaccine plane for DRC. Jeremy Farrar asked Bob Redfield and me where the FDA comes down on this issue. I spoke the Phil Krause and Bob spoke to Peter Marks. They understand the unusual nature of the current circumstances in DRC and completely understand what we are suggesting regarding a wider vaccination effort. As expected, they have no “official FDA position” on the issue since it does not involve them. The only implications for FDA would be if J & J wanted to use data from the vaccine distribution for regulatory purposes. However, that does not impact the public health rationale for moving ahead with a more widespread distribution of the vaccine. They agree that under emergency circumstances the public health requirements should drive the decision making. Bob putting together a letter (that I edited) from Alex to Tedros explaining all this to him. Alex to have phone call with Tedros today. We meet with DRC president tomorrow at HHS.

Did TV interview on measles outbreaks with Canadian National TV (CTV) via Face Time (new way to do TV interviews. Also spoke with Jeannie Baumann Bloomberg Law about our opioid-infectious diseases paper in JID. Also did interview with Susan Scutti of CNN on the press release of starting the phase 1 trial of Barney Graham’s nanoparticle-stem-group 1 universal flu vaccine.

Culmination of the tension between HHS (me, Bob Redfield, Alex Azar; also Jeremy Farrar) and WHO on whether to be more aggressive in a geographic vaccine program for DRC. Azar had an “uncomfortable” conversation with Tedros this AM since Tedros is apparently balking at the widespread use of the J & J Ad26/MVA vaccine and Azar is pushing it. Apparently my conversation with Tedros on Apr. 2 did not convince him, or so I imagine. The Tedros/Azar phone call took place immediately before we all met in Conference Room 607G at HHS with DRC President Felix Tshisekedi and his team of advisors. Azar pushed hard to convince Tshisekedi to embrace the widespread use of J & J vaccine. Tshisekedi was non-commital, but indicated that he wanted to work closely with the USA and dissociate DRC from China. Both China and Russia have Ebola vaccines that they are pushing, but they are way behind the J & J product that has gone through Phase 2 in Cliff’s trial. Azar relied heavily during the meeting on Bob Redfield and me to convince Tshisekedi. WHO is afraid to be aggressive since they are afraid of adverse events with the vaccine used widely. U.S. Ambassador to DRC Mike Hammer was at the meeting and gave me some insight that the Congolese really do not trust white people who come into their country and get excited over 1100 cases of Ebola when thousands of Congolese are dying from other diseases and starvation. We do not help them with those problems; then why are we so concerned about Ebola. They feel we are looking out for our own interests.

(Saturday) – The saga continues. I spoke on the phone today with Bob Redfield, Stewart Simonson (from Geneva) and Tedros (who was with Stewart in Geneva). There seems to be some misunderstanding that I will hopefully help to straighten out. After talking with Tedros this AM, he does not feel that there is any serious disagreement with Azar in that Tedros (as he indicated to me on previous phone calls – see above) is in favor of an “aggressive” vaccine approach with J & J product in surrounding areas in addition to continuing the ring approach with VSV in contacts. The disagreement seems to be on how we are describing the situation. Azar (and Bob) want to say that the outbreak is “out of control” and therefore that is why we need to expand vaccination. Tedros disagrees in that he feels that in certain areas of DRC, the outbreak has been well controlled and it has not spread to other countries. He agrees that in certain areas and in the fact that there are around 10 new infections each day, often without link to contacts, that it is dangerously not controlled in certain areas and there is a “risk” that it will get out of control. Tedros is afraid that if we say that the epidemic in generally “out of control” that this is not only factually incorrect, but it would demoralize the 700 WHO workers who are there under dangerous circumstances trying to contain the outbreak. In the end, whatever you call it or however you characterize it, the solution is the same, namely that we need to mount an aggressive vaccine campaign to prevent it from spreading further and to extinguish it. I will contact Alex Azar and try to mediate this with him. Spoke with Alex (he called me in response to my e-mail to him) and explained my conversation with Tedros. I told Alex that we really were not in disagreement. Alex felt better about this.

Spoke on 3-way call with Bob Redfield and DRC Minister of Health Oly Ilunga Kalenga encouraging him to go with the aggressive vaccine program that we had been discussing. He appears to be on board. Did CBS Radio (NYC) interview on outbreak of Candida aures
Spoke with Stewart Simonson in Geneva and explained my conversation with Minister Ilunga Kalenga so that Stewart can brief Tedros so as not to catch him off guard. Did Reuters TV on measles outbreak

Did a podcast for Dan Diamond at Politico. He was the reporter that broke the Sec. Price travel scandal at HHS. It was largely a praising of my career. Have been intensively busy (and fatigued) with measles, Ebola (see about), AFM, Candida auris, Hearings, etc. Apr. 11, 2019 – Did Fox Morning News this AM (7:30 AM) on Candida auris and measles. Testified before Senate Appropriations Subcommittee Hearing on the FY2020 NIH budget. Went well. Got asked the predictable questions about: measles, Candida auris, HIV plan to end the epidemic in USA, and sepsis
Did interview with Sanita Informazione (Italian Health News Website) on measles in NYC Did interview with WTOP Radio on Candida auris and measles

Appeared on Fox America TV to discuss the measles outbreak. Warm Saturday. Enormous traffic downtown as I went to and from the Fox studio on 400 North Capitol Street. Due to Cherry Blossum parade diverting traffic from Constitution.

Intensifying interest in more measles outbreaks. Did Canadian TV on Global News Network. Did Bloomberg News TV interview (taped) with David Rubenstein on the braod subject of infectious diseases. Appeared on FOX Business TV for Measles and Candida auris outbreak in hospitals. Tragedy – Notre Dame Cathedral is on fire and burning down. Cause unknown.

Did 30 minute interview on Sirius Radio – “Doctor Radio” on influenza and specifically the Phase 1 trial of our universal flu vaccine (Barney Graham – stem of Group 1 on a ferritin nanoparticle) Also did CNN New Day with Alisyn Camerota and Sanjay Gupta on measles outbreak in NYC Taped (for tonight) and NPR All Things Considered with Lisa Chang interview on measles Did FOX Business TV with Cavuto Coast to Coast on measles

Measles frenzy continues. 555 cases so far in 2019. 25 hospitalizations and 2 children in intensive care. Epicenters are still Williamsburg Section of Brooklyn and Rockland, NY in Hassidic Jewish communities. Two cases now in Pikesville, MD. I did interview on WTOP radio this AM (6;10 AM) Also did The Hill TV – streams online at their website. Also did Politico print interview; did interview with Israel National TV via skype Did interview with Wired on people who volunteer for vaccines Taped interview for NBC Nightly News with Lestor Holt/Anne Thompson on measles complications in the context of an Israeli Flight Attendant who developed measles and encephalitis and now is on life support Finally, did interview with Fox Nightly News on measles
Measles still front and center. Did interview with Betsy MacKay of Wall Street Journal

More Measles – MCM (Montgomery County Media) TV A Cameroonian physician working in an ETU in DRC was killed by terrorists who are now giving warnings that they will kill anyone who says that Ebola exists in DRC and will kill those working in the clinics. Very bad scene!

Did another Measles podcast – What’s Trending Podcast (Neurology). Went to dinner at the Jefferson Hotel (Wayne and Catherine Reynolds). Guest of honor was Stefano Pessina, CEO of Walgreens Boots Alliance (worth $11 Billion). Also guest was Nadia Murad the Hazidi girl who was taken as a sex slave by ISIS and then escaped and won the Nobel Peace Prize. Usual cast of friends at dinner: David and Holly Petreaus, Justice Anthony Kennedy and wife Mary, Roy Blount and wife Joan, Debbie Dingell, Steve and Alice Rosenberg, Martine Rothblatt. Terrific evening. Bonded a bit with David Petraeus.

Measles continues to dominate. Did NPR “Morning Edition” radio. Also did KYW Radio in Philadelphia. CBS Radio Chicago; and CBS Evening News KYMA NEWS 11 Radio Yuma, AZ Southern California Public Radio – NPR Had Deputies meeting (I did via SCIF) that took place in the Situation Room of the White House on the DRC Ebola situation. I described our RCT for therapeutics. We now have 197 people enrolled in a 500 person trial (4 arms – mAb114, Regeneron, ZMAPP, Remdesivir) Got e-mail from Bono that have chronic Lyme disease. He wants my help. Seems he has gotten under the influence of the fringe group.

Janet Tobias was with me all day filming different scenarios for her documentary on me. She did the Goergetown O’Neill Law Center talk, our Cytokine meeting, a manuscript meeting with me, Tae-Wook and Mike Sneller and then she filmed me driving home with Chris and then Chris and I cooking and eating at home.
More measles. People talking more about getting boosts. Did WISR Radio – Pittsburg PG County TV WJLA-Channel 7 TV (David Lucas)

Partner 2 study on U = U in 76,991 condomless acts in 783 sero- discordant MSM couples and no linked transmissions. Did long intervierw on BBC Radio. Multiple low level print outlets of measles and Dow Jones (background) on universal flu vaccine. Science News print story on measles Spent much of today still doing interview with Janet Tobias for the documentary

Got call from Bob Redfield. CDC now has data from Zuckerberg Institute and Columbia (Ian Lipkin) that enterovirus D68 is in fact the cause of AFM. He wants to partner with us in developing a pilot vaccine. He feels that the VRC is best positioned to do this (I agree and am pleased that CDC is not off trying to develop a vaccine themselves). I will set up a meeting/call between CDC (Bob and Nancy Messonnier) and us (Mascola, Erbeling, me) tomorrow. More violence in DRC hindering the Ebola response.

Did interview on measles with WKNU Logan, UT Radio Got call from Jon LaPook from CBS to ask my advice on a piece he is doing on anti- Vaxxers. He wanted to give a number of how much great a chance of dying from measles there is than from dying from measles vaccine as a dramatic end to his piece. I convinced him that this was not a good idea since someone would take issue with the calculation and this could smear his whole piece. The anti0-vaxxers are nuts and they would pursue this.

He said DRC was essentially a basket case without any government for decades. That is why they have the problem in Northeastern DRC right now. Good meeting. I explained to him how Uganda was the model for PEPFAR. He was pleased. That night we took off on commercial (Sabena/United) for home since MILAIR was still out of action due to waiting for mechanical part.

PCC today. No need to speak up sicne I alreadt spoke offline to Bob Redfield and Garrett Grigsby and told them my opinion. Garrett sent me a letter in which the TZ government asked for $9.9 million in USG aid for Ebola preparedness. Garrett asked my opinion of how to respond. I wrote back to Garret with the following

statement:

Garrett: My take on this is as follows. In the context of not rewarding bad behavior, I suggest that we respond positively that we are willing to help with the requested financial aid ONLY on the condition that they become transparent about the ongoing situation in TZ regarding the woman who died and the supposed contacts of that woman. The absolute condition for financial help is that they allow us access to samples to confirm or identify the diagnosis in the expired woman. I would make our letter private at first, since if we make it public, then they will surely take that as a public accusation of their bad behavior, which I am sure will only have them double down on such behavior. I have a feeling that they are using this request as an implicit suggestion of a quid pro quo. “You (USG) give us help ($) and we will start cooperating and be transparent”. However, if we go public with our response, we run the risk of embarrassing them and shutting down further negotiations. Bottom line: Respond privately with an offer to provide the requested resources under the conditions that I mentioned above. Hope that this is helpful. Best regards, Tony Garrett totally agreed with me. More to come.

Unusual meeting in the NIH SCIF with the NSC (Erin ?, O’Neill, Phil Ferro) and people from State Department China Desk. Issue is the role that the Chinese are playing in building a large genetics capability in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, which is the “seat” of the African Union (AU). Apparently, there is a movement to create an African CDC and genetics capability will be an important part of it. There is great concern that if the Chinese take the lead in building the genetics facility in Addis, then they will control the enormous amount of information on human, plant and animal genetics in Africa. Chinese genetics – Chinese Genetics Institute (CG I). NSC sees this as a security risk for us and the discussion is how we can stop this and figure out other ways to building that building such as paying for it ourselves. The Chinese originally offered to build it , but with a couple years delay. The Western nations were asleep at the wheel and let the agreement go forward without realizing the potential downside. Now everyone is exercised that we need to stop this. Deb Birx is particularly concerned from her vantage point as head of PEPFAR. I was called to the meeting because of my “knowledge and standing and because I am Tony Fauci”. We will have additional meetings about this.
